name: pidots
description: An implementation of pi as agents in a GPUI-kit shell, native macOS app with WebView.

scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && node desktop/scripts/bundle-agent.mjs dist/computer-agent
scripts.desktop: npm run build && swift build -c release --package-path desktop/computers && codesign --force --sign - --entitlements desktop/macos/computers.entitlements desktop/computers/.build/release/pidots-computers && swift build -c release --package-path desktop/speech && codesign --force --sign - --entitlements desktop/macos/speech.entitlements desktop/speech/.build/release/pidots-speech && cargo run --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n web,shell "npm run dev" "cross-env PIDOTS_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 cargo run --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml"
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests *.json *.ts *.js index.html public desktop/README.md README.md docs --ignore-unknown
scripts.check-format: prettier --check src tests *.json *.ts *.js index.html public desktop/README.md README.md docs --ignore-unknown

author: Fractal Mandala
